Reporting to the Senior Director, Earned & Owned Strategy, this individual contributor role will oversee integrated Earned & Owned programs spanning SEO, Content Marketing, and broader strategic initiatives designed to strengthen discoverability, drive measurable business growth, and evolve client visibility within AI-driven search environments. We offer: -Remote-first culture -Unlimited PTO -Extended Holiday break (Winter) -Flexible schedules -Work from anywhere options* -100% paid parental leave -401(k) matching -Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance -Sponsored life insurance -Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance -Annual Class Pass credits and more! The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above) and an annual performance bonus. This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. jobs.title: Digital Media Planner (Direct IO - B2B)
jobs.description: The Role We're looking for a Digital Media Planner (Direct IO - B2B) to own publisher direct and partner media for one of Wpromote 's largest B2B accounts: a leading financial software company whose products span mid-market ERP, advanced small business accounting, and marketing automation. You'll sit within our B2B team, surrounded by a full account team of strategists, channel leads, analysts, and coordinators, and you'll be the person who makes sure the client has the right media partnerships to hit their goals. This is a role for someone who likes the partner side of media: building relationships with publishers and vendors, running RFPs, negotiating, and holding partners to the same performance standard as any self-serve platform. Budgets are sizable and move often, so you'll need to be comfortable with change and clear-headed about where the dollars should go. At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.
